question: The Department of Pharmaceuticals has given 'in-principle’ approval to the proposals to set up bulk drug parks in three states- Himachal Pradesh, Gujarat and ________ under the scheme of "Promotion of Bulk Drug Parks".
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Central government of India has granted 'in principle approval for three bulk drug parks located in **Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• These parks aim to ensure a steady availability of essential drug components and strengthen India's** drug security.**
 
• **Bulk Drug Parks** are specialized industrial parks or zones dedicated to manufacturing and producing bulk drugs or active pharmaceutical ingredients (**APIs)**.
 
• **These parks** are designed to provide a conducive environment and infrastructure to attract pharmaceutical companies and promote the domestic production of essential drugs. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The state of Andhra Pradesh was formed in **1953**.
 
• The capital of Andhra Pradesh is** Amaravati**.
 
• The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh is **Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy**.
 
• The official language of Andhra Pradesh is **Telugu**.
